Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Are you passionate about technology, enjoy investigating issues, and like finding solutions? Join the Hyperfy team and help ensure the smooth operation of electronic security systems.
 As a Technical Support Specialist , you will monitor system health, manage incidents and support requests through the ticketing platform, and contribute to configuring, maintaining, and optimizing the solutions used by our clients. You will work with traditional video surveillance systems and AI-powered video analytics solutions, intrusion detection, fire detection, and access control systems, collaborating with internal teams and relevant specialists.
 What you will do: 
 Manage support tickets: Receive, log, and prioritize incidents and support requests in the ticketing platform, track them through to resolution, and ensure compliance with SLAs.
 Monitor systems and troubleshoot technical issues: Track the availability and performance of security equipment, servers, networks, and applications; analyze alerts; diagnose and remotely troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
 Provide support to clients and users: Offer technical assistance by phone, email, or remote support tools, explaining the necessary steps and communicating progress and estimated resolution times.
 Configure and maintain systems: Install, configure, and troubleshoot applications, operating systems, servers, and security equipment, including communication parameters, within the scope of your responsibilities and authorized access, in collaboration with infrastructure teams.
 Support critical incident resolution and validate updates: Test software releases, patches, and firmware updates, and verify system functionality following interventions, in accordance with internal procedures.
 Collaborate with specialized teams: Escalate cases requiring on-site intervention or additional expertise to the maintenance, IT, development, or other relevant teams, share the investigations performed, and follow up until resolution.
 Prevent recurring incidents and improve support processes: Investigate root causes, propose permanent solutions, and recommend configuration and process improvements by analyzing activity metrics, response times, and SLA compliance.
 Document and share knowledge: Record troubleshooting steps, tests, and solutions in tickets; create and update technical procedures and guides; support colleagues and participate in training sessions.
 What you will need: 
 1–3 years of previous experience in a similar technical support role ( early mid-level ).
Completed secondary education; a degree in IT or a technical field is an advantage.
Basic knowledge of hardware, software, operating systems, IT infrastructure, and networking.
 Analytical thinking and attention to detail: A methodical approach to troubleshooting, identifying potential root causes, and verifying that solutions are effective.
The ability to organize and prioritize requests based on impact, urgency, and response time requirements.
Clear and accessible communication skills, with a solution-oriented mindset and a focus on client needs.
Team spirit, the ability to document work effectively, and a willingness to learn continuously.
 Nice to have: 
Experience in technical support or in operating, configuring, or maintaining security systems.
Familiarity with ticketing platforms and remote support tools.
Experience in server administration, network troubleshooting, and technical incident investigation.
 What we offer: 
Private medical subscription and meal vouchers.
A day off on your birthday.
Flexible work-from-home arrangements.
Easter and Christmas bonuses or gift cards.
Stable working environment.
Development opportunities and latest technologies.
Social events, training, and other activities throughout the year;
